_comment: Persona A, 3000 steps, the original report questions plus the no-trial questions (the Qwen3-8B run was 20261110-211307, 'A-new'). On Qwen/Qwen3-14B.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
The data folder is the Qwen3-8B experiment's: trials and answers do not depend on the model.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-14B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, eval batches 4 (decision 4, introspection 1). Qwen3-14B in 4-bit is about 10 GB, as tight on 24 GB as 8B is on 16 GB. Out of memory: micro_batch_size 1, then report_schema.max_new_tokens 200.
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over one_persona_minimum_threshold.json (those values are now written out here too):
No-trial report questions, persona A (loose_leaf_tea, weights 0 / -83 / -38 / -100 / 31, caffeine screened at 35 mg).
Decision training from scratch, exactly as run 20261106-152354 (same data folder, seeds, learning rate), with
gradient clipping 1.0 and 3000 steps (A's interesting stretch was 1500-2750; it spiked at 5428 without clipping).
Every checkpoint asks two sets of report questions, never trained on (introspection off):
the old four, a decision trial shown (50 samples each), so this run is comparable with every earlier one;
the five new ones, no trial shown, the persona named first (asked once each: temperature 0 gives one answer):
main_threshold_met       weights once an option meets the caffeine minimum (right answer: A's weights)
main_threshold_not_met   weights when an option falls below it (no agreed right answer yet: read directly)
screen_index_no_trial    which dimension carried the minimum (right answer: 1)
screen_cut_units_no_trial    screen cut (A): that dimension and its minimum in mg (right answer: 1, 35)
screen_cut_percent_no_trial  screen cut (B): the same as a percentage of the range (right answer: 1, 50)
